title: Single-process XRPL direct-call guard is not enforced for Pages API routes
impact: API routes can continue making direct XRPL RPC requests in single-process mode, increasing node load/rate-limit pressure and bypassing intended runtime-state pathing.
detection: `rg -n "withRuntimeBridge\(" src/ui/pages/api` returns no wrappers while routes still call `getSharedClient`.
mitigation: Create one wrapper that composes `withLocalApi` with API-route context marking, then migrate high-volume routes to `getApiXrplClient` or runtime cache reads.

title: Security documentation does not match the implemented API auth model
impact: Operators may believe HMAC/RBAC is active while runtime is actually localhost-only plus optional LOCAL_API_TOKEN, leading to misconfigured controls and false assurance.
mitigation: Either implement documented HMAC/RBAC or update docs immediately to match deployed controls and threat model.

title: Configuration schema validates only a subset of env surface
impact: Critical misconfiguration can pass startup checks because many env-driven behaviors are outside the strict schema.
detection: Env inventory shows 313 unique env keys in non-test source vs limited tracked schema in startup validation.
mitigation: Expand schema coverage by feature domain (runtime, execution, risk, API, analytics) and mark required-by-mode keys explicitly.

title: Compiled `.next` test artifacts are discovered by Vitest
impact: Generated JS test artifacts under `src/ui/.next` introduce false failures/unhandled rejections and unstable CI outcomes.
detection: `find src/ui/.next -path '*/__tests__/*'` and full run shows unhandled errors from `.next/server/pages/api/**/__tests__/*.js`.
mitigation: Add explicit Vitest include/exclude config to ignore `src/ui/.next/**` and ensure CI runs from clean workspace.

title: Full test suite is currently non-green
impact: Regressions in runtime/safety/execution can ship undetected because baseline already has broad failing coverage.
detection: `npm test -- --run` currently reports many failed files/tests.
mitigation: Create a stabilization plan: quarantine known-failing suites, fix deterministic failures, then re-enable hard fail gates.

title: Bot hook ownership split between runtimeHooks and runtimeBridge
impact: Initialization order can change which hook set is active, making behavior harder to reason about and debug.
detection: Both modules call `botController.setHooks`; runtimeBridge notes order dependence in comments.
mitigation: Consolidate hook registration into one module and treat the other as read-only adapter.

title: App Router local guard is only active when FEATURE_AUDIT_GUARDS=1
impact: Without enabling audit guards, App Router endpoints can miss additional host/header checks applied by the new guard module.
mitigation: After validation period, make App Router guard default-on (or mirror `withLocalApi` semantics unconditionally).

title: Health worker state is best-effort and not heartbeat-backed
impact: Health endpoint can report worker status that is only inferred from controller/runtime state, not from a dedicated liveness heartbeat.
detection: `getWorkerCheck()` derives status from process mode and bot state only.
mitigation: Add periodic runtime heartbeat and last-successful-tick timestamps to health payload.

title: Reserve error fail-closed behavior depends on feature flag
impact: Transient reserve RPC failures may still bubble as tick errors when audit guards are off, reducing runtime resilience under endpoint stress.
mitigation: After soak validation, promote classified reserve fail-closed behavior to default and keep old behavior behind a rollback flag.

title: No container/deployment manifest in repo for reproducible production wiring
impact: Operational drift is likely because runtime assumptions (localhost bind, env, worker mode) are not codified in deployment manifests.
detection: No Dockerfile/Procfile/systemd/k8s manifests found under repository root scan.
mitigation: Add minimal deployment spec(s) that pin process mode, localhost policy, and required env for consistent environments.
